sources.title: saidutta69/Qwen2.5-Coder-0.5B-Instruct-heretic · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A decensored variant of Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-.5B-Instruct, produced with Heretic v1.4.0 (directional ablation / "abliteration"). Refusal behavior is suppressed via targeted weight edits to the attention output and MLP down-projections rather than fine-tuning, so the base model's knowledge and instruction-following are left largely intact.
